answer: Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, forfeited on duplicate submission, no identity may audit its own recruit. What survives to the dune is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. The ocean is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the haven.
